recommendations.description: Open a targeted inpatient provider remediation workstream for CT PPO acute hospital YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL, IN HMO/POS acute hospital ELKHART GENERAL HOSPITAL, and GA HMO acute psych LAKEVIEW BEHAVIORAL HEALTH and GREENLEAF BEHAVIORAL HEALTH HOSPITAL to validate contract-compliant reimbursement, prior-auth-to-claim matching and denial enforcement, and review alternative management or site-of-care options for concentrated admissions.
evidence: Yale New Haven Hospital drove +$16.7M in CT PPO acute hospital.
Yale admissions rose by 176 with higher paid per admit.
Lakeview and Greenleaf added 162 GA acute psych admissions combined.
Elkhart added 38 IN acute hospital admissions across HMO and POS.
Operational cards carried auth_dimension_present and repeated_delta_concentration flags.
peer_benchmarking: Optum Health shows no DRG-specific inpatient policy in the reimbursement inventory.

recommendations.description: Conduct a market-by-market inpatient acute-hospital review for KY HMO and PPO, CA/CO/GA/NH/NV/NY/TX HMO, and CA EPO claims in Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC, Vaginal Delivery without Sterilization or D&C with CC, and Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC to isolate service-line variance, review utilization management KPIs, confirm prior authorization where required, validate authorization-to-claim matching and denial enforcement, and confirm claims processed per contractual obligation.
evidence: KY HMO acute hospital added +$5.8M with 196 more admissions.
KY PPO acute hospital rose despite 38 fewer admissions from higher paid per admit.
CA/CO/GA/NH/NV/NY/TX HMO acute hospital added +$6.2M.
GA and CO craniotomy cases led HMO acute-hospital growth.
CA EPO craniotomy cases added 14 admissions.
Additional spend came from delivery, chemotherapy, and neuro activity.

recommendations.description: Conduct an auth-to-claim matching and denial-enforcement audit for Commercial Individual members in ME HMO ACUTE HOSPITAL inpatient admissions with pa_required_code Y, review initial and concurrent review KPIs for non-ER IP Med/Surg admissions, and target the review to MAINEHEALTH MAINE MEDICAL CENTER PORTLAND and Allogeneic Bone Marrow Transplant admissions.
evidence: ME HMO acute hospital utilization is volume-led.
Admissions rose while average paid per admit fell.
pa_required_code is Y for the impacted population.
Drill context shows non-ER IP Med/Surg admissions.
Drill context includes MAINEHEALTH MAINE MEDICAL CENTER PORTLAND.

recommendations.description: Run an auth-denial enforcement and claims-processing validation for AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION and Not Mapped inpatient claims in ME, CA, GA, TX, WI, KY, IN, and CT, isolating MaineHealth Maine Medical Center Portland, Santa Clara Valley Medical Center, Parkland Health and Hospital System, Norton Hospital, and the affected Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC, Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC, and Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC cases, and remediate facility classification or reprocessing logic not applying contractual authorization standards.
evidence: ME AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION showed apparent movement without utilization or unit-cost read.
CA and GA / TX / WI showed apparent auth-bucket shifts.
KY HMO Not Mapped facility growth added apparent impact.
Source groups flag requires_validation_before_action and auth_or_mapping_shift.
peer_benchmarking: Point32Health requires medically necessary care at contracted facilities; certain transplants require Medicare-approved facilities.

recommendations.description: Conduct a case-level itemized bill, authorization-to-claim, and DRG assignment audit for Heart Transplant or Implant of Heart Assist System with MCC at Yale New Haven Hospital, spinal fusion infection admissions at Norton Hospital, Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC at Santa Clara Valley Medical Center, and Coronary Bypass without Cardiac Catheterization without MCC at Elkhart General Hospital; validate catastrophic claim reimbursement handling.
evidence: Providers include YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL, NORTON HOSPITAL, and SANTA CLARA VALLEY MEDICAL CENTER.
Heart transplant or heart-assist cases added +$1.4M on 2 admissions.
Spinal infection and complex fusion run added +$2.1M on 2 admissions.
Rare craniotomy and neurosurgical cases added +$4.1M in CA.
Highlighted cases consistently show pa_required_code = Y.
peer_benchmarking: Fallon Health reimburses modifier 62/66 separately; modifier 66 requires three or more surgeons.
Moda Health allows modifier 62 for qualifying procedures and disallows same-specialty tag-team primary billing.
United Health has no DRG-specific co-surgery rule; only CPT 64727/69990 microsurgery addressed.

recommendations.description: Implement a Commercial Individual pre-discharge site-of-care policy in TX and CA for auth-required recovery admissions that requires alternate discharge review, prior-authorization confirmation, step-down timing review, and contract-processing validation before approving Physical Rehab, LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL, NF, or CRITICAL ACCESS placement for Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC and Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC.
evidence: TX HMO Physical Rehab admissions increased for Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC.
CA EPO LTCH added high-paid admits for Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC.
TX aftercare and hemiplegia cases concentrated in recovery-oriented pathways.
NF, CRITICAL ACCESS, LTCH, and Physical Rehab are impacted settings.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health internal policy bundles inpatient and outpatient facilities, including treatment and recovery rooms.

LUKE'S MEDICAL CENTER billed as "Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC" with diagnosis "ENCOUNTER FOR ANTINEOPLASTIC CHEMO" to confirm prior authorization was obtained, authorized services matched actual inpatient claims, and inpatient site-of-care and medical-necessity review processes are appropriate.

Paid per admit rose by about $6.4K.
Increase concentrated in one chemotherapy episode type.
PA required, non-ER, acute hospital admissions.
Rendering provider: AURORA ST. LUKE'S MEDICAL CENTER.
